summary.text: Jackie Henry is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Nick Frentz (D).
According to her campaign website, she grew up on a family farm in Nicollet County and has worked as a financial planner and Medicare broker.

paragraphs.text: Henry's campaign website says she was born and raised on her family's dairy, hog and crop farm in Nicollet County and graduated from high school in 1968.
It says she later earned a business degree and ran a financial-planning practice as an independent contractor for 36 years.
From 2003 until her husband retired in 2020 she handled day-to-day operations at AJ Henry Fence Company, according to the site.
She sold her practice in 2017 and now works as an independent Medicare broker, the site says.
Henry's campaign describes her as a candidate serving Mankato, North Mankato and St. Peter who is running on accountability and affordability.

sources.title: Meet Jackie - Jackie Henry for Senate
